## SK Hynix Undertakes $720 Billion AI Memory Expansion With Economy-Wide Impact on South Korea

A $720 billion commitment — headline-stated — makes SK Hynix one of the largest single-company capex bets in semiconductor history; for PM, it validates the HBM demand outlook but also concentrates execution risk — yield, technology transitions, and balance sheet leverage all matter at this scale.

- CNBC feature details SK Hynix's $720 billion AI-driven memory expansion — figure stated in the headline.
- Scale of buildout described as having economy-wide effects within South Korea.
- Confirms SK Hynix as a primary infrastructure beneficiary of the AI capex supercycle.
- HBM supply expansion is framed as the central strategic driver.
